ln:4455728250.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Business Analysis.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own solution design for Credit platform capabilities across application, decisioning, simulation, and reporting.
  • Lead the Business Analysis practice within the Credit platform, embedding consistent standards, templates, and ways of working.
  • Partner with business and IT stakeholders across multiple countries to translate goals, priorities, and requirements into clear, actionable deliverables.
  • Act as the bridge between business, risk, operations, and engineering teams.
  • Represent Credit Technology in project working groups and governance forums, driving alignment, decisions, and timely delivery.
  • Create epics, user stories, business requirements, and functional specifications with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Produce functional designs for stories planned for development, including process flows, data mappings, business rules, and exception handling.
  • Support the Product Owner with backlog refinement, prioritisation, dependency management, and release planning.
  • Lead technical design reviews, architecture alignment, and delivery planning.
  • Drive integration with upstream and downstream systems, including trading, risk, finance, and data platforms.
  • Ensure quality through clear acceptance criteria, test strategy, QA support, and release governance.
  • Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
  • Support regulatory, audit, and control requirements in solution design and rollout.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in credit domain platforms within banking or financial services.
  • Proven track record as a Tech Lead, BA Lead, or in a hybrid role within complex transformation programs.
  • 10+ years’ experience delivering IT change in Agile and/or hybrid delivery models.
  • Experience delivering projects in Wealth Management and/or Private Banking.
  • Strong domain knowledge across Credit, Wealth Financing, and Investments.
  • Hands-on understanding of enterprise architecture, APIs, event-driven integration, and data workflows.
  • Strong skills in requirements engineering, process modeling, stakeholder management, and impact assessment.
  • Experience delivering across the SDLC lifecycle in agile and controlled enterprise environments.
  • Fluent English communication skills, written and spoken.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proficient with delivery and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Data analysis capability, including SQL, defining data requirements, and supporting data quality and reconciliation.
  • Ability to define and validate non-functional requirements, including performance, resilience, availability, observability, and scalability.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4469186859.descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description

This job is responsible for the delivery of integrated treasury and working capital solutions to multi national corporate clients and their regional treasury centers. Key responsibilities include actively managing and pursuing treasury revenue inbound streams along with increasing product penetration across an assigned regional portfolio and partnering closely with client-facing teammates to consult on sales opportunities. Job expectations include providing product knowledge to deliver the best possible solution to meet the client and prospect’s needs across Asia Pacific.

Responsibilities

  • New sales wins in China and across Asia Pacific, revenue growth and retention within a predefined portfolio as a corporate sales consultant across all BofAML markets – across treasury, trade and FX
  • Engage key decision makers of the largest and most demanding clients advancing the relationships from 1) access 2) dialogue 3) material relationship 4) pipeline 5) mandate, to 6) strategic advisor
  • Work closely with other regions and corporate banking team to deliver solution to our clients
  • Pro-active approach to sales, sending unsolicited proposals, lead client engagement and pitches / presentations
  • Respond to RFPs (request for proposal)
  • Constantly review client names to ensure that the names achieve and maintain hurdle profitability levels or exit the relationship based on the Bank’s business objectives.
  • Identify and implement revenue opportunities for names assigned via cross-sell opportunities through ongoing discussions with clients
  • Coordinate with implementation and services teams to ensure a smooth implementation and high client satisfaction
  • Ensure timely resolution of relationship-sensitive client servicing issues within the organization and act as the senior escalation point in relationship-sensitive key service issues
  • Completion of ad-hoc projects related to names and accounts

Requirements

  • Relevant cash and trade sales or relationship management experience within a top tier international/ regional bank
  • Proven track record in managing complex cash and trade deals for multinational corporations
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in Mandarin Chinese and English.
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Strong inter-personal and organizational skills
  • Able to successfully develop and maintain collaborative working relationships
  • Strong financial skills
  • Knowledge of Corporate Treasury functions
  • Strong client engagement skills with an unwavering focus on client satisfaction and growing business
  • A strong team player who understands how to leverage various businesses functions/partners to drive business growth and support the US client management and sales teams
  • Willing to travel cross-regions and within the region.
  • Strong PC skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc)

ln:4476869095.descriptionHtml:
The Sec & Derivatives Sr. Mgr. is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to process orders and transactions originating from trading desks and branch offices in coordination with the Operations - Transaction Services team. The overall objective of this role is to ensure the seamless delivery of securities and derivatives transactions.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement business initiatives, client solutions, or projects affiliated with securities and derivatives settlement
  • Solve complex inquiries, conduct discovery and complete due diligence activities for client requests
  • Provide detailed analysis of escalated issues when necessary and recommend actions for resolution
  • Contribute to processing standards and expectations for securities and derivatives processing teams
  • Develop and implement business plans, policies, and procedures that offer solutions and cost saving opportunities
  • Manage daily performance related to securities and derivatives post-settlement activities of operations processes
  • Propose solutions to implement settlement process improvements, client service enhancements, or overall technology enhancements
  • Coordinate with internal and external clients to assess service quality and identify areas for improvement
  • Act as an advisor to new/junior staff
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of relevant experience
  • Required licensing/registration: Series 9
  • People management experience
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family Group:

Operations - Transaction Services

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family:

Securities and Derivatives Processing

------------------------------------------------------

Time Type:

Full time

------------------------------------------------------

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

------------------------------------------------------

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

------------------------------------------------------

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

ln:4477282815.descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support line manager to manage regulatory risk, ensuring the governance of all on-site and off-site regulatory inspections, regular or ad-hoc visits are well organized, and monitor regulatory commitments etc.
  • Support line manager to provide oversight on CFCC governance from Compliance Risk perspective.

Business

  • Support Compliance Risk Assessment, ensure appropriate escalation of Country issues to CHoC and the relevant Country risk forums.
  • Follow appropriate processes for escalation and resolution where losses or issues occur, in relation to risks owned by CFCC.
  • Assist Head of CFCC Governance to implement group initiatives set out in Enterprise Risk Management Framework and when rolled out in China, such as Country RAM tracking, stress test, Rubik Metrics, and etc.

Processes

  • Maintain the central inventory of on-site regulatory inspections, provide advices and supports on regulatory on-site examinations and further improve inspection management and systemizing the handling process, prepare the MI and regulatory reports on on-site regulatory inspections.
  • Track regulation assignment and implementation status for the regulations assigned to CFCC governance.
  • Render timely and proper assistance to action parties during relevant Compliance process.
  • Be the country LKCS coordinator including creating, amending and maintaining all LKCSs in Operational Risk System.
  • Support, facilitate and provide compliance advice on regulatory requirements, inquiries and opinions for support functions.
  • Coordinate the self-assessment on market disorder conducted by cross-functions.
  • Proceed any ad-hoc jobs assigned by line manager.

People & Talent

  • Increasing engagement with a range of stakeholders within the business and the functions
  • Take responsibility for own personal development and training in line with the Banks principles and guidelines.
  • Ensure all mandatory training is completed on time.

Risk Management

  • Proactive identification of compliance risks ensuring these are managed and escalated appropriately and timely

Governance

  • Contribute to the development and production of suite of management information for senior stakeholders, where possible

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for supporting the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets; Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • 1st LOD Function team
  • 2nd LOD and 3rd LOD team

Other Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on supervisory and risk control, including but not limited to
  • Contribute in the formulation or amendment of risk control and accountability policies
  • Participate in the internal investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of failure to perform the duties on supervisory and risk control

Skills And Experience

  • Thorough knowledge of banking products and services, such as RMB settlement, cross-border RMB, FX under current and capital account, BOP, AML related, and the latest new polit policy for biz promotion.
  • More than 6 years work experience in banking industry, especially in Ops, TB, Compliance, or relevant regulator background
  • Sound knowledge of local regulatory requirements, local banking practices and requirements including but not limited to RMB XB and FX self-discipline mechanism, FTZ policy, credit bureau policy, individual FX policy, etc.
  • Strong local regulatory relationship management skills and have healthy relationships with key depts. of regulators, such as capital account division, current account division, BOP, AML, Financial stability, foreign bank supervisory department, etc
  • Good judgment enabling the provision of sound advice in ambiguity areas of regulation and practice and the proactive management of compliance and regulatory risk in the city
  • Deep knowledge of the process critical for implementation of risks and controls
  • Deep knowledge of execution and supervision of the compliance related process, and that of regulatory requirement.
  • Good understanding of the bank's overall business and operation for co-ordination with other teams
  • Deep knowledge of execution and supervision of the compliance related process, and that of regulatory requirement.
  • Handle most compliance enquiry independently.
  • Strong risk sense and the ability to assess risk in the branch

Qualifications

  • Good knowledge of regulatory requirements, ability to interpret regulatory requirement, identify and assess relevant laws and regulations to provide solutions to stakeholders.
  • Good skill of financial risk management, and good knowledge of bank structure, operation procedure and operating models.
  • Good communication skills with an understanding of key relationships, ability to deliver clear information to different stakeholders, and ability to interact and build relationship with all levels of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive and creative approach to work, self-motivated and pragmatic. Takes responsibility and accountability for own tasks.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

- Propose solutions to implement settlement process improvements, client service enhancements, or overall technology enhancements
- Coordinate with internal and external clients to assess service quality and identify areas for improvement
- Act as an advisor to new/junior staff
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
Qualifications
- 6-10 years of relevant experience
- Required licensing/registration: Series 9
- People management experience
- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
Education
- Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree preferred
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of FUND ACCOUNTANT.

Principal responsibilities

  • Calculation and disbursement of management, advisory, administration, performance and custody fees;
  • 基金净值计算 （每日，每周或每月）；

  • 管理，咨询，资产服务，业绩和托管费用的计算和支付 ；
  • Clearing reconciliation breaks between Broker and our books of records;
  • 账目核对，检查并处理账目系统与银行流水中的缺失科目；
  • File records of correspondences and processed instructions for audit purposes;
  • 记录通信和客户指令的文件用于审计目的的；
  • Accounting and accrual of fund expense;
  • 基金相关费用的会计分录及支付；
  • Delivery of accurate and timely report to Clients.

  • 能够承受一定的工作压力和在规定时间内完成日常工作；

  • 接受早晚班的轮班制。

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist (AVP - AI Strategic Transformation).

Business:CTO

Job ID: 57754

Location: Shenzhen

Principal Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Support the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme, including maintaining plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs and related tracking, and helping ensure deliverables remain aligned to wider programme expectations.
  • Programme governance and reporting: Support the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream by preparing status updates, coordinating inputs for steering and programme forums, and helping maintain an accurate and timely view of progress, risks and key outcomes.
  • Cross-workstream integration: Work with stakeholders across the Group AI programme to track dependencies, surface issues, and help ensure partnership-related activities, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the broader programme view.
  • Strategy development and execution: Support the Director, Innovation & Partnerships in the development and execution of the function's strategy by conducting analysis, preparing materials, coordinating follow-ups, and helping translate agreed priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Operating rhythm and governance: Support the operating rhythm for the Director and wider team by coordinating agendas, preparing materials, capturing actions, and tracking progress to completion.
  • Team effectiveness and organisational health: Contribute to team initiatives including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability-building activities and team-wide coordination that support an effective and collaborative environment.
  • Special initiatives: Support strategic projects and analyses on behalf of the Director and the wider team, helping frame issues, gather inputs, develop materials and support implementation.

Governance and Committee Memberships

  • Supports the preparation of agendas, papers and actions for relevant team forums and contributes materials and coordination for Group AI programme governance activities as required.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Work collaboratively across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, building strong working relationships and supporting delivery across a matrix environment without direct line management responsibility.
  • Contribute to team effectiveness by connecting activities across stakeholders, communicating clearly, surfacing issues in a timely manner, and following through on agreed actions and commitments.

Requirements

  • Programme coordination: Experience supporting complex programmes, projects or workstreams in a large organisation, including planning, dependency tracking, risk management, governance and status reporting.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure problems, conduct analysis, and contribute to clear, well-supported recommendations for management audiences.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing clear materials, updates and presentations for senior stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Good ability to work with a range of stakeholders across business, technology and external partnership environments to support alignment and execution.
  • AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services, with the ability to engage with colleagues on key topics and translate technical developments into business-relevant updates.
  • Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are managed and governed within a large, regulated organisation.

/WX

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4490557363.descriptionHtml:
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Supporting tasks to assist in maintaining and strengthening distribution channel relationships, whilst coordinating the relevant business initiatives.
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, enhance insurance sales capabilities, and achieve sustained performance growth.
    • Train core competencies across the full sales process, implementing insurance sales competency development, including execution of phone appointments, in-depth KYC, case solution and closing.
    • Train and coach RM to how complete Policy Review and analyse Policy Review Reports to customers
    • Participate in customer events and training sessions, assist with pre-event preparations, provide on-site support, and conduct post-event evaluations and follow-ups.
  • Support relationship managers in analyzing and diagnosing client needs, designing tailored solutions, and preparing for client meetings. Enhance practical capabilities through role-play and rehearsals focused on solution presentation and deal closing.
  • Provide coaching on sales strategies for INSH proprietary products, building on the foundational training delivered by Business Development Managers. Help relationship managers improve practical product skills, including aligning product features with client needs and integrating relevant service resources.
  • Analyze market trends and competitor products to identify and articulate the core strengths of INSH products. Develop sales strategies aligned with client profiles, incorporating sales logic and applicable scenarios. Continuously refine strategies through case reviews to improve sales effectiveness
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, assisting RM to complete pre-case/pre-meeting.
  • Supporting the development and execution of channel development plans and strategies, continuously optimizing existing cooperation models.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders, which may include relationship managers and product team, to maximise empowerment for distribution channels.
  • Assisting in execution of compliance review processes and due diligence to ensure all operations adhere to risk control requirement.
  • 协助建立并维护与分支行及相关业务部门的良好合作关系，确保合作顺畅及内部服务体验。
  • 负责提供一对一教练式的陪跑辅导，实现知识向技能转化，提升保险销售能力，以实现绩效持续稳定的增长。
    • 训练全销售流程的核心技能，实施保险销售能力养成，包含电话约访、深度KYC、解决方案呈现及成交等。
    • 培训并指导客户经理如何完成保单检视，并指导如何为客户分析保单检视报告。
    • 参与行所沙龙及内部培训等活动，配合做好活动前相关准备工作，提供现场赋能支持，并做好活动后的评估及。活动效果的跟进。
  • 协助客户经理完成客户需求分析与诊断，设计解决方案；并做好相应面谈准备，通过演练、预演递交解决方案及成交过程，提升客户经理的实战作业能力。
  • 负责产品强化训练辅导，针对INSH自有产品在由业务发展经理完成的销售资质培训基础上开展产品销售策略的训练辅导，帮助客户经理提升产品相关的实战能力，包含产品功能与客户需求的匹配分析，以及与产品功能相关的服务资源整合。
  • 负责市场及同业产品对比分析，通过分析提炼INSH产品核心优势，结合销售逻辑及应用场景，整理与客户概貌相匹配的产品销售策略，并通过典型案例复盘持续优化策略，提升销售有效性。
  • 支持制定并执行新业务拓展计划与策略，持续优化现有合作模式。
  • 与产品部门、客户经理及相关团队保持紧密协作，最大化赋能合作渠道。
  • 严格协助执行相关客户尽职调查及合规审查工作，做好风险控制。
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Reasonable experience in sales force (5 years )
  • Possess board-based knowledge of the Insurance business and China practices
  • Good influential skills – able to influence people of different cultures and backgrounds
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese. Must be able to communicate effectively in Putonghua.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills – excellent customer relationship management
  • Able to lead, inspire, motivate and develop the teams to deliver business performance and a team player.
  • 具备5年以上销售或业务相关工作经验，有银行渠道或金融机构合作经验者优先
  • 熟悉保险业务及金融产品，了解国内银行渠道业务模式及监管要求
  • 具备良好的沟通协调能力及影响力，能够与不同层级的银行人员建立有效合作
  • 中英文口头与书面沟通能力优秀，必须能流利使用普通话进行商务沟通
  • 具备较强的客户服务意识及关系维护能力，能妥善处理渠道合作中的各项事务
  • 具备团队协作精神，能配合内部团队共同推动业务发展，达成整体目标

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4490547683.descriptionHtml:
汇丰保险经纪业务成立于2022年，作为我们在中国内地保险和财富产品分销的经纪渠道。作为汇丰集团的一部分，我们在中国内地致力于通过财富规划服务业务助力人们提高抵御风险能力、为他们自己及其亲人提供保障，实现他们的人生目标。

汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。

汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，

通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：

  • 厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
  • 匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
  • 代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
  • 产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；

工作职责

主要工作包括：

  • 拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
  • 代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
  • 通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
  • 确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。

任职要求

  • 本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
  • 3年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者或其他行业5年以上销售或销售管理经验
  • 善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
  • 积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
  • 渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
  • 具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
  • 具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑
